scientific_lineage: Spacesuit electrical wire-break/arc ignition thresholds at NASA White Sands Test Facility; extension of STS-113-era spacesuit materials ignition tests
lineage_exclusions: 20070006358 Electrical Arc Ignition Testing of Spacesuit Materials
other papers/presentations/test datasets from the same spacesuit wire-break/arc ignition campaign, including STS-113-era data
exposure_before_freeze: Metadata/abstract only for reserved investigation; no PDF/fulltext acquired or inspected. LUCI is post-exposure development. Pretraining exposure unknown.
adjudication: Developer source verification; no claim of independent expert adjudication. Review original body/evidence and report explicit denominators; full scientific precision/recall only where source-adjudicated.
checks: Original source bytes, NASA origin and source identity preserved
Current/cited/planned studies distinguished; documentary rows do not become executed runs
Named investigation/groups/materials and experimentally supported configurations reconstructed
Exact original quantitative values, qualifiers and units; derived/uncertain roles preserved
Observation/conclusion subjects and documented scope independently supported; no blanket run distribution
Relationships require original contextual support, not co-occurrence
Ontology reuse and minimal extensions stay staged; no global concept activation
Unresolved/rejected/omitted science and inaccessible figures explicitly accounted
Normal CurationService submission/preparation/export, source integrity, idempotence, no approval/publication
acceptance: Technical completion alone is insufficient. Any critical false source/run/epistemic attribution fails scientific acceptance. Report partial scientific recovery without claiming full Phase1 completion. Source inventory is not scientific gold.
response_policy: No prompt/schema/semantic alias/code/resource-contract tuning from final answers. Retain failure as failure. Further development requires development sources and a subsequent prospectively established independent evaluation cycle.

resources.call_count: Source-adaptive; whole source windows first, then finite original-span splitting and source-omission recovery. No four-entity ceiling or small fixed document-call cutoff.
resources.total_token_budget: No added paid allocation. Existing authorized free endpoint only; successful actual usage recorded, incomplete usage conservatively reserved. Finite recovery/progress controls bound work by source structure.
